noticias.titulo: The origin of every great product lies in its ingredients
noticias.texto: We connect new raw materials and innovation with the industries that are transforming the world, with technical advice and flexible volumes for your operation.
Non-ionic surfactants of renewable origin for cosmetics and cleaning: gentle on the skin and effective at cleansing.
For selected items, we sell materials in small quantities (1–5 kg) so you aren't left with excess inventory.
Vitamins, amino acids, proteins and extracts for formulating dietary supplements, with batch documentation.

home.industriasTexto: Browse by industry or combine product line filters to land exactly on the raw material your formulation needs.
home.lineasTexto: Find the raw material by the function it performs in your formula: active ingredients, surfactants, emollients, colorants and more.
home.bannerTitulo: No surprises between the website and your warehouse
home.bannerTextoHtml: In this industry the physical form of a raw material can change with the manufacturer, the origin and the batch: what one supplier ships as flakes, another produces as beads or powder. That's why our portfolio describes reference presentations and we always confirm the technical data sheet of the available batch before you buy.

bannerBullets.texto: “Flakes, beads or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch” — we say it that way because that's how the market works.

bannerBullets.titulo: Data sheet for the actual batch
bannerBullets.texto: Before we invoice, we share the exact specification of what we're going to ship.
Validate the material in your lab before scaling up the purchase.

home.procesoTitulo: From quote to your plant in four steps
home.procesoTexto: The whole commercial cycle runs on WhatsApp: fast, traceable and with a technical advisor on the other end.

pasos.texto: Message us on WhatsApp or send the quote request form with product, quantity and end use.
We share the technical data sheet, safety data sheet and certificate of analysis of the available batch.
Approve the quote and pay by bank transfer, Bre-B or the method agreed with your advisor.
We ship nationwide with the packaging and the supply chain documentation.

home.destacadosTexto: The specialties most in demand among our formulator clients.
home.valoresTitulo: A supplier that speaks your lab's language
home.valoresTexto: We don't just sell line items: we support formulation, documentation and logistics end to end.

valores.texto: For selected products we sell from 1 kg: for development, pilot runs or production, with no need to buy a full drum.
Technical data sheet, safety data sheet (SDS) and certificate of analysis available for every shipment.
We help you choose the right raw material for each formulation and resolve technical questions with sound judgment.
Guidance on the INVIMA and ICA requirements that apply to your industry, with no fine print.
Deliveries in Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla and the rest of the country through logistics partners.
Request batch samples to validate in the lab before scaling up your purchase.

faqs.a: Presentations depend on whether the product is liquid or solid. For liquid products we offer drums, jerrycans and product dispensed by the kilo; for solid products we offer sacks, boxes and product dispensed by the kilo. In both cases, it depends on the nature and availability of the product.

faqs.q: What are the minimum order quantities?
faqs.a: For selected products, we sell from 1 kg upward.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Bank transfer and Bre-B (Colombia's instant payment system).

faqs.q: What is the minimum order value for shipping within and outside Bogotá?
faqs.a: In Bogotá, we ship orders over COP 500,000. Outside Bogotá, orders over COP 1,000,000.

faqs.q: What documentation comes with the purchase?
faqs.a: Technical data sheet, safety data sheet and certificate of analysis for the shipped batch.

nosotros.descripcionMeta: Origen Chemical connects new raw materials and innovation with the industries that are transforming the world, with technical advice and relationships built on trust.
nosotros.heroTitulo: What if every great product had its origin in better-chosen ingredients?
nosotros.misionTexto: We connect new raw materials and innovation with the industries that are transforming the world, helping our clients turn their ideas into reality and building relationships based on trust and respect.
nosotros.visionTexto: To be a national benchmark in the distribution of innovative raw materials for a range of industries, recognized for the quality and diversity of our portfolio, the excellence of our team and our ability to build relationships of trust with our clients.
nosotros.principiosTexto: They're the reason a client who buys from us once tends to stay.

principios.texto: Request the technical documentation for your raw materials from our sales team to verify that their specifications match your formulation requirements..
Whoever answers your WhatsApp knows the difference between an anionic and an amphoteric surfactant. If we don't know something, we check with the manufacturer — we don't improvise.
We quote fast because production doesn't wait, but every shipment leaves with its full documentation. Speed without paperwork isn't service, it's risk.
We work with international manufacturers and we also champion ingredients from Colombia and LATAM because the region's biodiversity is world-class raw material.

nosotros.entregamosTexto: We operate from {direccion}, in Bogotá, shipping to the country's main cities through partner carriers, and we coordinate scheduled deliveries for plants running a production plan.
nosotros.compromisoHtml: Transparency commitment: no description on this site promises physical form, purity or guaranteed performance. Everything is confirmed with the batch's technical data sheet before the sale — that's how we avoid the complaints this sector knows all too well.
nosotros.lineasTexto: Twelve lines organized by the function they perform in the formula, each with its own filtered portfolio.
nosotros.ctaTitulo: Let's talk: your process deserves a good supplier
nosotros.ctaTexto: Tell us what you produce and what your supply chain needs. That's our area of expertise.
